violations.title: Cold Holding

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: SINGLE SERVICE CONTAINERS USED AS SCOOPS IN PREPARED FOODS: CURRY CHICKEN, 65 SAUCE, CURRY SAUCE IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED SCOOPS AND DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE PROVIDE SCOOPS WITH HANDLES FOR DISPENSING FOODS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions: FOR CHLORINE SANITIZING DISHWASHING MACHINES.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH/CHLORINE test kit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ONLINE ORDER FOR TEST KITS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the HANDWASH SINKS AT DISHWASHING MACHINE AND PREP SINKS piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE REPAIR IS COMPLETED.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program

violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils: OPEN JARS OF BEVERAGES USED FOR DRINKING STORED ABOVE THE PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands: EMPLOYEE DONNING GLOVES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS BEFORE ENGAGING IN FOOD PREPARATION.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink: AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HANDWASHING SINK ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the END OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK being used TO THAW FROZEN SHRIMP.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO TRANSFER THAWING SHRIMP TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR TO COMPLETE THAWING. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINKS ARE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink: AT END OF THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. CHANTILLY BIRYANI GRILL (Inspection Date: 02/24/2026) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED OVER RAW FISH IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REORGANIZE FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW FISH STORED OVER COOKED CHICKEN AND VEGETABLES IN M3 TURBO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; RAW CHICKEN STORED OVER COOKED VEGETABLES AND PREPARED SAUCES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REORGANIZE FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. RICE AT 89-94F (2.75 HOURS) IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINER IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD RICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE COOLED FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS USING PROPER COOLING METHODS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BUTTER BATTER CHICKEN AT 56F ON COUNTER; PEELED BOILED EGGS AT 69F ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: SEVERAL FOODS PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR WITHOUT DATE MARKING STORED IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR AND M3 TURBO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR - COOKED MUTTON, CURRIED MUTTON, CURRIED CHICKEN, DAHL, BUTTER SAUCE, ONION SAUCE, 65 SAUCE, KARALI CHICKEN, TANDOORI CHICKEN, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS PREPARED AND HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS ARE DATE MARKED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): BIRYANI RICE, CHICKEN BIRYANI, MUTTON BIRYANI, BATTER FRY CHICKEN ON COUNTERS IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC THE TPHC DOCUMENTATION FOR FOODS USING TPHC PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: RICE AT 89-94F (2.75 HOURS) IN DEEP COVERED CONTAINER IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD RICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE SHALLOW, UNCOVERED PANS IN FREEZER OR REFRIGERATOR ARE USED TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS TO THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS..

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED SHRIMP AND CHICKEN THAWING IN STANDING WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER SHRIMP TO WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AND CONTINUE THAWING CHICKEN UNDER RUNNING WATER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EDUCATION PROVIDED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORK CONTAINERS, SPRAY BOTTLES AND SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS, SAUCES, SPICES, HERBS, SALT, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING ARE LABLED, COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: IN USE UTENSILS STORED IN CONTAINERS OF WATER AT 79-84F ON STOVE TOP.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REPLACED UTENSILS AND CONTAINERS WITH WATER AT 135F OR ABOVE. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS were found stored DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN SERVER AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE USE DUNNAGE RACKS OR APPROVED SHELVING FOR STORAGE OF SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS. CHANTILLY BIRYANI GRILL (Inspection Date: 02/24/2026) Page 4 of 5

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: PLASTIC GROCERY BAGS USED TO STORE FOODS IN WALK IN FREEZER AND WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE USE ONLY FOOD SAFE BAGS OR NSF APPROVED UTENSILS FOR FOOD STORAGE IN REFRIGERATION UNITS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: ON MOP SINK FAUCET CONNECTED TO CHEMICAL DISPENSING SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE FOR MOP SINK FAUCET WITHIN 3 DAYS.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED GREASE TRAP CONNECTED TO THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AND DISHWASHING MACHINE LEAKING HEAVILY UNTO THE KITCHEN FLOOR FROM THE FRONT SURFACE OF THE GREASE TRAP.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. MANAGEMENT INDICATED LEAK STARTED AFTER GREASE TRAP CLEANING SERVICE COMPLETED EARLIER IN THE DAY. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REQUEST IMMEDIATE SERVICE TO REPAIR LEAK. out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cleaning and Sanitizing
violations.observation: During a discussion with the manager, it was discovered that employees are not properly sanitizing cleaned multiuse equipment and utensils before they are reused. They are rinsing large cooking equipment that won’t fit in the warewashing machine with the quaternary ammonia sanitizer and not submersing the entire piece of equipment in the sanitizer for at least 30 seconds, as required.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train his/her employees to properly sanitize all equipment, utensils, and surfaces after being cleaned using either an approved sanitizer at the adequate concentration or heat sanitization at the proper temperature to destroy pathogenic bacteria. The EHS trained the manager and the food employee on how to properly set up and use the sanitizer basin of three compartment sink and to submerge large food equipment that won’t fit in the warewashing machine in it to properly sanitize. The manager had the food employee properly set up the three compartment sink.

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. The health department will send a copy of the permit. Post it in a conspicuous location when received.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. There was no certified food manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. The certified food manager arrived during the inspection.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department emailed and reviewed handouts.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information emailed at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS emailed the forms for all staff to sign before the follow up. CHANTILLY BIRYANI GRILL (Inspection Date: 08/27/2025) Page 2 of 6

violations.title: When to Wash

A food employee did not wash his hands when changing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The EHS spoke with the manager about this and the manager spoke to the employee. The employee properly washed his hands.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS had the staff member go back to the hand sink as required.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels provided at the bar handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The EHS discussed this with the manager. The manager corrected this by placing a roll of paper towels at the bar handsink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The manager moved the foods to their correct locations.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: white rice cooked yesterday was stored in a large covered container in the walk-in and was 46 F.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: there were several unlabeled foods on the cook line (spices and ingredients), in the refrigerators (ready to eat foods), and on shelving (large containers of spices in storage) that were not lableled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The manager had the food employees label all the unlabeled foods during the inspection to correct this.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are being used to control pests (the manager showed the EHS a pest control invoice), but there are numerous fruit and drain flies present at the read of the kitchen by the water heater, and in the bar area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Recommend increasing pest control frequency, methods, or both the get the fly problem under control. Ensure correction before the follow up.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes do not have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents. One of the back doors was propped open with no screen in place.
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means. The manager closed the propped open during to correct this during the inspection. CHANTILLY BIRYANI GRILL (Inspection Date: 08/27/2025) Page 4 of 6

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Foods in the kitchen, walk-in refrigerator and freezer, the wait station, and the outside storage container located outside were stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Correct before the next routine inspection.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. Food employees were not wearing hair restraints when the EHS arrived.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Staff quickly put on hair restraints to correct this during the inspection.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. The EHS informed the manager of this requirement. Correct as soon as possible or by the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The manager corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Dry Wiping Cloths and Sanitizer Solution Free of Food Debris
violations.observation: Heavily soiled wiping cloths in use.
violations.corrective_action: Dry and wet wiping cloths shall be free of food debris and visible soil. Change out soiled dry wiping cloths more frequently, or store them in a properly mixed sanitizer solution between uses.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: in-use utensils were stored in 90F standing water and bowls were used to dispense foods in several locations (dry storages, prep refrigerators, the walk-in, etc.).
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The manager heated the water for utensils storage to 135F and removed the bowls being used to dispense foods to correct this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean equipment (bowls, plates, etc) in storage were observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. The EHS discussed this with the manager. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection in six months.

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Several stainless steel pans, frying pans, and other equipment were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. The EHS discussed with the manager that equipment and utensils must be air-dried prior to stacking.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean large cooking pots, cooking equipment, single service items and other items were stored on the floor in several locations including the outside storage container located outside.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS discussed with management. Ensure correction before the next inspection.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed boxes of single service items (e.g. take home containers) stored in direct contact with the floor in the kitchen and/or outside storage container.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS discussed that nothing shall be directly stored on the floor. Ensure correction before the follow up.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: white five-gallon buckets and their lids were being reused for food. The buckets are permitted, but the lids are not. Plastic grocery bags were being used to store and cover foods in the freezer,
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. remove the lids and cover with an approved product.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard and aluminum foil was being used to line multiple shelves in the kitchen, walk-in and dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. The EHS informed the manager that shelving may not be lined with aluminum foil or cardboard, that they should be removed, and that cleaning should be done instead. CHANTILLY BIRYANI GRILL (Inspection Date: 08/27/2025) Page 5 of 6

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: shelving over the prep line was not clean, interiors and exteriors of microwave ovens, inside some refrigeration units, work tables and shelving below the work table.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS discussed cleaning and sanitizing more often to remove food debris and residue. Ensure correction before the follow up.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line of the sanitizing basin of the 3-compartment sink and the sewer line. No air gaps are provided on the drainage line which connects each sink in the three compartment sink, and the food prep sink next to it.
violations.corrective_action: A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed. The EHS informed the manager that he must contact a plumber to install the required air gaps and remove the direct connection. The manager called the plumber during the inspection. The EHS provided the manager with a diagram showing the correct way to insert air gaps. Manager made the call to the licensed plumber.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacle with Drains, Drain Plug Required
violations.observation: The trash dumpster used to store refuse has no drain plug.
violations.corrective_action: Drains in receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall have drain plugs in place. Contact the vendor and have the drain plug installed, or obtain a new dumpster.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. They were not being air dried.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. The manager corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps in the ceiling panels over the water heater which need to be repaired and sealed to prevent vermin entry.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Correct before the next routine inspection in six months.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 20 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the consumer self-service areas, reach-in refrigerators, handwashing areas, warewashing areas, equipment and storage areas, and/or toilet rooms. There was only one light in the back storage room near the back door and it was not working. There was one light bulb out in the cook line hood.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 20 foot candles in these areas. Install a new lightbulb or fix the light fixture before the next routine inspection in six months.
